row: Wildwood Farm Sanctuary is a 501c3 non-profit organization that provides life-long, peaceful refuge and rehabilitation for abused and neglected farm animals who serve as ambassadors, promoting compassion and inspiring change. Wildwood is named after our 98 acres of pasture, forested property and wildlife sanctuary located in Newberg, Oregon. Wildwood Farm Sanctuary was founded in 2010 by licensed veterinary technician Shauna Sherick who has been working with farm animals for nearly 20 years.
